headline: Fishermans Row Rekindles as Weathered Expanse Storm Rages On
war_summary: Fishermans Row, still at our last edition, is aflame anew: eight flags changed hands in the past two hours alone, thirty-two across the day, and the tally now reads seven works Colonial, one Warden, one in ruin, with Black Well and Eidolo the busiest posts. Weathered Expanse keeps its grim ledger at four works Warden, three Colonial, two ruined, while its twenty-four-hour casualty bill swells past twenty-three thousand and hourly counts still climb; fresh flags were logged there minutes before this edition closed. At Callahan's Passage, Crumbling Post slipped into no-man's-land shortly before deadline, that field's toll now exceeding nineteen thousand a day. The Bone Haft churns on in Farranac Coast; Stonecradle's five-four line bleeds afresh about World's End; Linn of Mercy's casualty rolls accelerate sharply though its eleven works hold Colonial. Stlican Shelf and Godcrofts, late of the liveliest churn, have fallen still, and Mooring County's slaughter runs on without a flag moving. The ledger stands 291 Colonial works to 133 Warden, five in ruin. Day 260; no victor declared.
